english.title: Failure to keep premises licence on premises and make it available on request - Gambling Act 2005
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being the holder of a premises licence issued under the Gambling Act 2005, failed without reasonable excuse to keep the licence on the premises and to arrange for it to be made available on request to

(A)_[a constable]_
(B)_[an enforcement officer]_
(C)_[an authorised local authority officer]_
english.legislation: Contrary to section 185 of the Gambling Act 2005.

english.notes: A licensing authority may institute criminal proceedings in respect of this offence, section 346(1) of the Gambling Act 2005.
